Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1255
Claimant:
Erin Flores
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2-1-25
Claimant reported a low-speed contact in a parking lot and stated they are not represented by an attorney. The
named driver on the policy is the one who reported the loss.
3-22-25
The reported neck strain fits the kind and force expected from this type of impact. The vehicle damage is consistent
with the described contact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
5-2-25
The police report and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the lot. Nothing suggests the damage
happened before the coverage start.
7-6-25
The claimant has told the same account in every conversation so far. Treatment has run somewhat longer than usual
for this injury. Records also show treatment for the same neck area within the last two years, and the provider notes
that this condition adds to the current complaints.
7-7-25
A nearby camera covers the location but shows no collision there at the reported time. This goes against the
claimant's account, so I have requested the full footage export before drawing any conclusions.
9-20-25
Coverage is confirmed active and the driver is listed on the policy. The file stays open pending the footage review and
the complete medical records, and I will follow up with the claimant once both are in.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
